title: choosing to accept your personality - a New Year Resolve
en: it is nearly the end of the year i hope you are proud of yourself and all you've accomplished just by getting through it it's been a historical trip around the sun one that we won't be forgetting anytime soon it has been a time of hardship and loss your inner strength has been tested and you have come through stronger than ever i am so proud of you i was grateful to be able to safely welcome the new year with some of my family i see them often and we deeply enjoy our time together speaking a mix of english and spanish we talk and laugh abroariously i feel so blessed to have them you may find this strange but i was so close to my parents and siblings growing up and so introverted that i didn't really make any other friends until i became an adult and lived alone that's when i realized how much i needed human connection but not in the way mainstream society has normalized it right

i am not able to sustain a life of much socializing going to parties and events i need time alone every day and while i do enjoy the excitement of getting out of my comfort zone and meeting new people i don't do it often and that suits me i'm blessed to have a boyfriend that understands this and shares my energy levels we've built a strong relationship through the similarity of our spirits um in my society sometimes i feel as if we value humans who take drastic and bold actions

over those who are more quiet and sensitive and consequently undetected i myself admire people who can attract the attention of an entire room give a speech or performance and seem completely in their element i have a brother who is in some ways quite extroverted and i greatly look up to him and enjoy his personality for a long time i wanted to be like him and others who i admired but it isn't who i am and i had to come to terms with that people like myself must confront life at a slower pace taking their time and not letting the busyness and rush associated with modern living take over lest they begin to wither and cave under the pressure of commotion do i had to stop trying to mold my personality and see it for what it was only then was i able to thrive and know what my spirit needed in terms of lifestyle

and socializing i'm not weaker or less interesting because i like to be alone i am who i am and whoever you are i hope you embrace it as well if you have ever raised a pet you know that training can only go so far and that individual creatures each have quite distinct personalities that even they cannot control we embrace it in them and others yet cannot always accept our own i hope this coming year you seek to be a better version of yourself not someone else through doing this i resolved long-held feelings of loneliness and insecurity i was comparing myself with personalities so different from my own that i felt alone when in fact there are many people like me more or less introverted who need differing levels of quietness in their lives to hear their own thoughts maybe you are not this way but you might know someone who is and seek to understand them better whatever this year holds for you see it as a journey that will offer you many opportunities and lessons it is up to you whether or not to take them i will be with you on that journey
and i will see you in 2021 you
zh: 快到年底了，我希望你为自己和你所取得的成就感到自豪，这是一次历史性的绕太阳之旅，我们不会很快忘记，这是一段艰难和失落的时期，你的内在力量受到了考验，你比以往任何时候都更坚强，我为你感到骄傲，我很感激能够与我的一些家人安全地迎接新年，我经常见到他们，我们非常享受在一起的时光，我们说英语和西班牙语。哈哈大笑，我感到很幸运有他们，你可能会觉得这很奇怪，但我在成长过程中与父母和兄弟姐妹非常亲近，而且非常内向，直到我成年并独自生活时，我才真正交到任何其他朋友，那时我意识到我是多么需要人际关系，但不是主流社会正常化的方式
我无法维持参加聚会和活动的社交生活，我每天都需要独处的时间，虽然我确实享受走出舒适区和结识新朋友的兴奋感，但我不经常这样做，但这适合我，我很幸运有一个理解这一点并分享我能量水平的男朋友，我们通过精神上的相似性建立了牢固的关系，嗯，在我的社会中，有时我觉得我们重视采取激烈和大胆行动的人

相对于那些更安静、更敏感、因此不易被发现的人，我本人很欣赏那些能够吸引整个房间的注意力、发表演讲或表演、并且看起来完全符合自己的风格的人。我有一个兄弟，他在某些方面相当外向，我非常尊敬他，很长一段时间都很欣赏他的个性，我想像他和其他我钦佩的人一样，但这不是我，我必须接受这样的事实：像我这样的人必须以较慢的节奏面对生活，慢慢来，不要让忙碌和匆忙联系在一起。随着现代生活的接管，以免它们在骚乱的压力下开始枯萎和塌陷，我是否必须停止尝试塑造我的个性并看到它的本来面目，只有这样我才能茁壮成长并知道我的精神在生活方式方面需要什么

在社交方面，我并不软弱或不那么有趣，因为我喜欢独处，我就是我，无论你是谁，我希望你也能接受它，如果你养过宠物，你知道训练只能走这么远，每个生物都有截然不同的个性，即使他们无法控制，我们拥抱他们和其他人，但不能总是接受我们自己的我希望来年你寻求成为一个更好的自己，而不是别人，通过这样做我解决了长期存在的孤独和不安全感，我将自己与自己进行比较个性与我如此不同，以至于我感到孤独，事实上有很多像我一样或多或少内向的人，他们在生活中需要不同程度的安静来听听自己的想法也许你不是这样，但你可能认识一个这样的人，并试图更好地理解他们，无论今年对你来说是什么，把它视为一个旅程，将为你提供许多机会和教训，由你决定是否接受它们，我会和你一起踏上这段旅程
